claims.limits: Different-target boundary errors measure fitting burden, not improvement in one common physical field. Equal wall allowances do not establish equal CPU/load or statistical replication.

decision.after_fail: Do not advance this target/recipe under this fitting allowance; no global impossibility claim.
decision.after_pass: Retain target as an ideal-improved starting point, not coil-feasible. If absolute boundary limits still fail, do not automatically extend fitting or run interior/long traces.
decision.further_diagnostics: Separate decision tied to substantially improved absolute field errors or a concrete topology question, registered before execution.
decision.inconclusive: Missing work, unresolved geometry, failed intake/startup, unclassified failure, source/environment/resource/clock/host interruption.
decision.negative: Complete eligible pair misses RMS/current/flux/geometry hurdle; a normal completed fit with documented no eligible candidate also rejects this bounded recipe.
decision.pass_requires: Both normal completed fits eligible, both fine shifts and continuous geometry complete/pass with current/flux and independent field checks; candidate worst fine RMS <=1.10 times control.

decision_question: Does the fixed ideal-improved target materially worsen boundary fitting under equal short fit allowances?
execution_prerequisites: frozen dependency inventories and receipt identities
fresh output and AC/owned assertion admission

fit.method: Existing six/order5 L-BFGS-B with unchanged penalties, eligibility and boundary-RMS selection; normal cap may keep earlier eligible candidate, probes cannot win, no fallback.

host.cleanup: After scientific termination, signal owned assertion, poll terminal and verify absence; preserve every attempt.
host.conditions: AC plus both owned assertions at admission, sample during and query after scientific termination; failed queries or observed loss invalidate enclosing result.

kind: paired fitting-burden screen, not coil feasibility
reuse: Both equilibria and ideal score receipts reused explicitly. No new solve, target tuning, ideal scoring, or matched historical solve-cost claim.

seed.description: Same original coil geometry; existing target-specific signed-flux normalization, then freeze selected currents before checking.
